info.description: Complete API documentation for KidDrive. Run `npm run seed` to populate test data. Test login: admin `admin@kiddrive.com` / `Admin@123`, parent `ahmed.ali@example.com` / `password123`, driver `omar.driver@example.com` / `password123`

post.description: Login with email and password. Use seeded test data: parent `ahmed.ali@example.com` / `password123` or driver `omar.driver@example.com` / `password123`
Login with driver credentials. Use seeded test data: `omar.driver@example.com` / `password123`

schedule.description: Array of schedule items with dayOfWeek (0-6), pickupTime (HH:MM), and dropoffTime (HH:MM)

post.description: Manually generate trips for a subscription. Creates 2 trips per scheduled day (pickup + dropoff).

daysAhead.description: Number of days ahead to generate trips

403.description: Forbidden - Can only generate trips for own subscriptions

get.description: Get all trips for a specific subscription
Get all trips for a driver from their active subscriptions. EP that drops trips.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter trips from this date (ISO format)

parameters.description: Filter trips until this date (ISO format)
